course_name_original: Basics of machine operation, diagnostics and repair
course_name_en: Basics of machine operation, diagnostics and repair
prerequisites: Basic knowledge in physics, necessary to understand basic phenomena occurring in mechanical engineering.
Has knowledge of the fundamentals of mechanical engineering.
Basic knowledge of computer science and measurement techniques.

learning_outcomes.text: Has a basic knowledge of the cycle of existence of machines and technical objects. He knows physicochemical basis of machine operation and the structure and construction of their essential mechanisms.
Has general knowledge of the use and maintenance, the assumptions of diagnostics and features of the technological process of machine repair.
Has basic knowledge related to selected issues of operation, diagnostics and repair of machines.

Be able to recognise the intended use of the machine and identify functional, design, maintenance and diagnostic features. Is able to design the process of using and operating a machine on the basis of knowledge of technical and operational parameters, and to develop a method of repairing a selected component or subassembly.

Is willing to identify safety hazards that may occur in the performance of tasks at the workplace, and to take into account in the operation, diagnosis and repair of machines the consequences of their impact on the environment and the consequences of decisions related thereto.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts and definitions of the components of an operational system.
Operational requirements of technical objects.
Exploitation system of machines.
Characteristics and operational division of machines and equipment.
Technical and operating documentation of machinery and equipment.
Performance characteristics of machinery.
Principles of safe use of machinery.
Diagnosis and monitoring of the condition of an operation object.
Diagnostics technical diagnostics and its assumptions.
Types of diagnostic tests.
Physico-chemical processes as sources of signals diagnostic.
Vibroacoustic diagnostics of machinery and equipment.
Principles of machine operation.
Basic wear processes in the process of operation.
Lubrication systems.
Principles of lubricant selection.
Maintenance system Technical inspections of machinery and equipment.
Overhauls of machinery and equipment.
Phases of the technological process of overhaul.
Costs and profitability of machinery operation.
Introduction. Developing instructions for a machine
Division of complex technical objects into operating subsystems.
Determination of operating characteristics of machines
Planning periodic maintenance and overhaul of machines.
Identification of types of damage to machines.
Measures - wear indicators for selected elements of subsystem
Selection of lubricants to the assumed operational conditions
teaching_methods: Lecture with multimedia presentation on operation, diagnosis and repair of machinery.
Assessment of wear, durability and performance of machinery.
Determination of technical-economic parameters of machinery maintenance.

assessment_methods.method: Discussion during lectures and laboratories and discussion of prepared exercise reports.
Using technical and operational documentation during planning of machine maintenance.
Evaluating the operating system of a selected machine Defining and distinguishing problems and diagnostic decisions and characterising types of machine faults.
Familiarising with the repair technology of selected machine components and assemblies.
Analysing the operation system in terms of safety and environment
Participation in tutorials, current control of knowledge from lectures, preparing and passing reports.

assessment_rules: The lecture component is assessed by 2 tests during the semester. The exercise component is assessed by participation in classes, current control of knowledge from lectures, and preparing and passing reports.
